title: Harden the named-root startup retry fixture against wall-clock process delays
outcome: Investigate and, when supported by evidence, isolate the startup retry fixture's real process-I/O timing from its deterministic admission-budget contrast without widening production limits.
acceptance: Record the real process-I/O boundary in ColdStartRootReader and distinguish injected pre-dispatch exhaustion from an unrelated warm-read timeout using deterministic phase controls or preserved failure evidence; no flake is claimed without an observed failure.

Any test change preserves the original two RED-discriminating assertions, production reclamation deadlines, and send/post-dispatch timeout cleanup; do not widen timeouts or add automatic retries to obtain green.

Evaluate optional transport controls for an already-warm process with an exhausted budget and a concurrent in-flight request; add meaningful deterministic coverage if it is needed to pin shared-process preservation.
